title: OCC Enterprise Data Management Support Services
agency_path: TREASURY, DEPARTMENT OF THE.OFFICE OF THE COMPTROLLER OF THE CURRENCY.COMPTROLLER OF CURRENCY ACQS
detail_text: This is a special announcement in regards to the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency's (OCC) Enterprise Data Management Support Services (SAM Notice ID # 2031JW26N00010). The OCC anticipates the solicitation will be released in quarter 3 of fiscal year 2026. The anticipated acquisition vehicle will be the GSA Alliant 2 Government Wide Acquisition Contract (GWAC). NOTE: NO FURTHER QUESTIONS REGARDING THIS REQUIREMENT WILL BE ANSWERED UNTIL THE SOLICITATION QUESTION & ANSWER PERIOD.
